newsitem.title: USA: Ford won't comment on Hertz IPO report.
newsitem.headline: Ford won't comment on Hertz IPO report.

text.p: Ford Motor Co declined to comment Wednesday on a report that it will choose J.P. Morgan & Co Inc over longtime investment bank Goldman Sachs & Co as the lead underwriter for an initial public offering in its Hertz Corp car rental unit.

Ford spokesman Christian Vinyard said the automaker is still reviewing whether it will sell a partial stake in Hertz. Ford said January 9 that it is reviewing strategic options considering a partial sale in Hertz that would realize value for shareholders.
"We're still evaluating the entire situtation with Hertz; that could result in a partial sale," Vinyard said.
The Wall Street Journal said Wednesday that Ford was expected to name J.P. Morgan as the lead underwriter for the offering as early as this week.
